mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY growth drops below -2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts (HOUST) signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the housing sector contracts.
failure_condition: HOUST MoM growth drops below -10% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rises by > 200k jobs in a month but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4%, the combination signals a late-cycle overheating that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed aggressively tightens policy.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE < 4% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate loans (RSAFS) are growing faster than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, the combination signals a credit-fueled demand boom that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS YoY growth > 10% and UNRATE < 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.
